channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Exit Ways
item.description: Exit Ways is a PvEvP survival extraction shooter. Grow your community in a zombie apocalypse. Rescue survivors, craft gear and build a base.

item.title: Hasbro's BATTLESHIP
item.description: Hasbro's Battleship is the original strategic naval war game. Choose your Captain, position your ships, aim your missiles and sink the enemy's fleet! Face them in Classic mode, or step-up the stakes in the all new Commanders Mode. Ready, aim, FIRE!

item.title: MD Engine
item.description: Create real Sega Mega Drive / Genesis games using drag-and-drop with no coding required. Export ROMs for original hardware, plus Web, Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, and Linux Handhelds.

item.title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 Costume Pack
item.description: Style up your brawl with this additional pack of ultimate costumes! Featuring a bonus costume for every brawler in the game.

item.title: PRAGMATA
item.description: Pragmata is a unique, sci-fi action-adventure game from Capcom. Follow Hugh, a member of an ill-fated investigation team, and Diana, a young android, as they navigate a lunar facility taken over by rogue AI in search of a way to Earth.

item.title: Pumpkin Woods
item.description: Collect magical ingredients and build your cozy witch home while exploring the wonderful sights and secrets of this mysterious land. Beware though, danger might be lurking deep in these woods...

item.title: Soul Chained
item.description: Bound by the Soul Chain, fight through purgatory as chained rival warlords using chain magic, teamwork, and terrible decision-making. Trip enemies, accidentally drag your partner to their death, and survive brutal bosses armed with suspicious amounts of jiggle physics.

item.title: TIEBREAK – GRAND SLAM EDITION
item.description: TIEBREAK - GRAND SLAM EDITION Compete in more than 100 official tournaments against over 150 officially licensed professionals. Take on the complete ATP and WTA Tours, including the Australian Open, Roland-Garros, Wimbledon and the US Open.

item.title: Tiny Eden
item.description: A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

item.title: Tower Lab
item.description: Enemies have no health, push them off instead. Weaponize physics in this roguelite tower defense game. Draft a deck, chain towers into living contraptions, grow and shrink every projectile, and launch hordes of robots off the edge.

item.title: Veterum
item.description: Turn-based tactical strategy with a detailed combat system and interactive environment. Explore the open world, complete quests, search for rare artifacts. Lead the last army of the Order of the Gatekeepers and stop the coming chaos!

item.title: Bones and Coins
item.description: An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

item.title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 Season Pass
item.description: 4 Additional brawlers join Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2! Grab all 4 of these additional brawlers at a great value and receive a bonus SpongeBob Squarepants “The Quickster” costume to best your foes in style.

item.title: F1® 25: 2026 Season Pack
item.description: Rewrite the grid with new teams Audi and Cadillac joining the grid, bringing a refreshed roster of drivers ready to challenge the field. Step into a new era with the groundbreaking 2026 cars & take on the adrenaline-fuelled MADRING.

item.title: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2
item.description: Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl 2 lets you duke it out with the biggest and best fighting character roster yet! Choose your favorite brawlers, master their unique move sets, and use all-new powerful Supers to land the finishing blow with friends or across a unique, roguelike player campaign!
